#### 2. 🏛️ **Unlocking Prifddinas ([Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End))**
You are extremely close to meeting all 10 Level-75 skill requirements! Here is what you need to finish:

* *(All other required skills—Agility, Crafting, Herblore, Mining, Prayer, Ranged, Summoning, Woodcutting—are already 75+!)*

#### 3. 🦅 **Bossing Target: Kree'arra**
* With **107 Necromancy** and **95 Slayer**, you can comfortably melt [Kree'arra](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kree%27arra) using your Ghost/Skeleton summons and Death Grasp spec setups.
* Pair an **Aviansies** Slayer task with your [Full Slayer Helmet](https://runescape.wiki/w/Full_slayer_helmet) for a massive boost to damage and accuracy!
